answer: Spectral channel fingerprinting: each identity must transmit on a distinct physical channel pair assigned at registration, and relays verify the channel's hardware drift against an atlas of calibrated noise signatures. Saffron-tagged calibration pulses expose cloned radios sharing one transmitter. A single operator cannot fake independent drift across many channels without separate hardware. Each extra identity costs a dedicated radio plus drift calibration, scaling attacker cost linearly with clone count through the canyon of physical uniqueness.
